categories_thin: Retail (non-food): only about ten independent shops found (pet supply, two florists, thrift, jewelry/gold, appliance/TV, electronics, mattress, motorcycle). Middlesex Borough's retail is thin and dominated by chains excluded by the brief.
Tutoring and test prep: no in-borough provider found; nearest are in East Brunswick and South Plainfield.
Art schools / pottery: none in the borough; nearby options are in Plainfield, Scotch Plains and Summit.
Hotels and independent inns: none found in the borough.
Tree care and pool service: only 2 and 1 providers respectively with a Middlesex Borough connection; most results were out-of-town firms that merely serve the borough.
Masonry, siding and window contractors: several exist but many advertise service areas rather than borough addresses, so only those with a borough address or stated borough base were kept.
caveats: Roughly half of the entries rest on bulk directories (NJ Business Directory, Loc8NearMe, BestProsInTown, Yahoo Local, Yellow Pages snippets) and have not been confirmed by a current website or recent map review; triage should verify.
Google Maps served a limited view from this browser profile (only 3 organic results per query), so map coverage is partial rather than complete.
Yellow Pages, Cylex, WhereOrg, Manta, Superpages, BBB, ChamberofCommerce.com and AllPages all returned HTTP 403 to automated fetching, cutting off several large directories.

Phone numbers are recorded only where a directory or the business's own site published them; many trade contractors list mobile-style numbers, which were left out where they looked personal rather than business.

Excluded as chains/franchises per the brief: Honest-1 Auto Care, The UPS Store, Jaeger Lumber, Camp Bow Wow Middlesex, Dollar Tree/Dollar General/CVS. BOC Gases was also left out as a multinational plant.
Industrial/manufacturing entries on Lackland Dr, Baekeland Ave, Cedar Ave, Blackford Ave and Hallock Ave are single-source NJBD listings; some may be inactive, holding companies, or shared addresses.
data_gaps: No official borough business registry / mercantile license list is published on middlesexboro-nj.gov, so the borough's own roster of licensed businesses could not be used as a ground truth.
Overpass/OpenStreetMap querying was not attempted beyond noting it is commonly blocked from this environment.

Street addresses are missing for about eight businesses that directories describe as Middlesex-based (Sami's Tree, Daivis Tree, Lipari Pools, J.C. Painting, Navarro Family Roofing, High Point Roofing, HomeCraft Paving, Falgi Carting, NDC Services, GEMCO).
Several addresses conflict between directories (Rhodes & Sons; Bomar Crystal; Little Miracles; JR Driving School), flagged in notes.
Manufacturer headcounts are unknown; any site with over 500 staff should be dropped by the analysts (NutraBio Labs is the most likely large employer).
